title: P15.9-B5.4: /app/chat — Conversation layer on the canonical P15.8 contract (AppShell)
description: P15.9-B5.4 R1 — independent-audit fix on PR #100. R1-F1 cross-session isolation: composer text is cleared on every session switch (unsent A text never displays or sends under B); pendingSubmit retains {sessionId,body,key} so a deliberate retry on return replays the SAME idempotency key; every mutation note (turn failure, confirm/reject/close, draft/proposal-draft create) is gated on the pinned session — a late A result never paints notes/dialogs into B; committed POSTs are never aborted. R1-F2 proposal project binding: a new proposal resets the pick and aborts stale validation; the pick is bound to the exact proposing message via proposalRef (obsolete project fetches gated by messageId); Create Draft stays disabled until proposalProjects validates against the canonical GET /api/projects list; submitProposalDraft re-checks active session, proposing message, candidate-set membership and verified canonical list immediately before POST — malformed/unavailable/obsolete evidence blocks with zero POSTs. R1-F3 malformed turn success: the whole canonical turn response (operator message + assistant reply, session-bound seqs, proposal shape) is validated BEFORE composer/pendingSubmit are cleared; a malformed HTTP 200 shows an unverified-outcome note, retains composer + idempotency key, refetches canonical history for reconciliation, never auto-retries — a deliberate retry replays the same key so the backend holds exactly one operator/assistant pair. Preserves all B5.4 functionality; UI-only; zero backend/schema/dependency changes.
